phase_objective: Determine, from immutable existing evidence only, what can and cannot be attributed about the seed-1630 bowl3 retreat collision without rerunning a seed or changing controller, task, physics, safety, capture, dataset, or training behavior.

authorization_provenance.statement: 先复盘思考你决策是否合理，再做下一步
authorization_provenance.scope_interpretation: Review the prior decision first, then execute the already-recorded next admissible read-only attribution. This does not authorize a simulation rerun, implementation change, collection, export, training, AMD/ROCm execution, hardware operation, or real-robot operation.

downstream: a separately frozen observability-only work package if existing evidence is insufficient
a separately frozen single-variable repair hypothesis only after sufficient causal evidence and new authorization

work_packages.objective: Review whether WP-G3-CORR-012 execution, terminal classification, evidence retention, and next-action ordering were justified by the frozen contract.
Audit source deltas, failure chronology, safety-classification semantics, preserved seed-1630 evidence, and four completed same-panel comparators.
Issue a bounded terminal decision and immutable local evidence receipt.

allowed_actions: write a new local planning record and terminal receipt
forbidden_actions: create or modify a remote file
train or evaluate a learned policy
operate AMD/ROCm, GPU, hardware, or a real robot

decision_review_questions: Was support-contact observability the smallest justified follow-up to WP-G3-CORR-011?
Was preserving the valid level-1 observation while rejecting downstream authority consistent with the frozen gate?
Was completing the remaining CPU simulation seeds after seed 1630 explicitly governed, or merely encoded in the driver?
Did the prior terminal model adequately distinguish observation validity from execution safety?
Is a read-only existing-evidence audit the minimal next action, and does it allow an inconclusive terminal?
attribution_questions: Did the v128-to-v129 source delta change retreat, controller, collision classification, physics stepping, or task behavior?
Did seed 1630 complete the consecutive-left inter-bowl transition with zero safety failures before the event?
Does the recorded contact satisfy the frozen robot-to-nonselected-bowl safety predicate?
Is seed 1630 an outlier on preserved bowl2 settled pose or transition timing relative to completed controls?

Do preserved files contain collision-time physics step, target interpolation fraction, robot qpos, clamp pose, bowl2 pose, contact position, penetration, normal, or force sufficient to identify a geometric or dynamic cause?

acceptance_matrix.expected: local predecessor terminal manifest and remote batch, run-file, and supervisor manifests verify
v128 and v129 hashes match the frozen predecessor and final hashes; the diff is limited to support-contact observability and metadata
transition receipt completes through bowl3 front clearance with zero safety failures; failure is recorded later during bowl3 retreat
the pair is robot-to-nonselected-bowl contact and is forbidden during retreat under the unchanged predicate
either all collision-time state required for causal attribution is present, or the terminal explicitly identifies the missing fields and is inconclusive
zero seed reruns, zero simulator starts, zero source/controller changes, zero remote writes, zero collection/export/training
contract validation remains valid and 813 local tests pass

terminal_states.COMPLETE_EXISTING_EVIDENCE_ATTRIBUTION_A: Existing immutable evidence identifies a bounded, reproducible collision mechanism without post-hoc threshold promotion or unsupported causality.
terminal_states.COMPLETE_EXISTING_EVIDENCE_ATTRIBUTION_I: Existing immutable evidence confirms chronology and classification but lacks collision-time state required to identify the geometric or dynamic cause.
terminal_states.FAILED_EVIDENCE_GATE: Required files, hashes, manifests, source identity, comparator integrity, or no-mutation evidence do not verify.

two_axis_decision.reason: Future records must not collapse an earlier valid observation and a later safety rejection into one ambiguous status.

claim_boundary: This work package can verify decision consistency, event chronology, classification semantics, source-delta boundaries, comparator facts, and evidence sufficiency. It cannot establish collision causality, reproducibility, a safe retreat path, a controller repair, source readiness, dataset readiness, learned-policy improvement, G3 passage, AMD/ROCm execution, hardware validity, or real-robot safety unless those conclusions are directly supported by the frozen existing evidence.
